  WHY: Only the diagnostic pool fields could be wrong, and the precondition is unlikely. Both reviewers rated this NIT. Sonnet-5_5 considered the same scenario and chose not to report it.

  WHY: Cross-engine dedup of heal lineage may split. Reviewers rated this NIT, and it is reached only when no `::error::` line exists. minimax gave confidence 3, glm gave 2.

  PROBLEM: The stderr capture helper does not verify that clarify_attempt_stderr_file under ${RUNTIME_DIR} is writable, so a misconfigured runtime dir can silently produce pool_*=unknown.
  WHY: The diagnostic line would show the failure mode this change was meant to fix. Rated NIT.
